QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_33

question.text: If an AIF's Investment Manager fails to achieve First Close within which period from the date of SEBI intimation, the AIF must file a fresh application for launch?

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.5: Unsuccessful First Close — if First Close is not achieved within 12 months from date of SEBI intimation, AIF must file fresh application. This delays fund deployment. The Trap: Options A, C, D do not match the regulatory window. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B tests the 12-month rule; III-A covers the re-application procedure. Manager's Pro-Tip: Plan your marketing roadshow backwards from month-9 — getting LPs to wire commitments in month-11 is a coordination nightmare. Have a conditional soft-circle of at least 50% of target corpus before formal SEBI intimation.
